changes.reason: SSR pages with and without deferred regions use one absolute deadline and request cancellation checks. The Lambda buffered limit covers the complete HTML without deferred regions, and ISR waiters coalesce a replacement fill when the previous owner disconnects.

kubernetes.reason: The Node fetch adapter forwards the request signal to the existing renderer. Local HTTP tests exercise the adapter but do not establish Kubernetes deployment behavior.
constraints: Client disconnect detection depends on the HTTP server forwarding it as a request abort.
The Lambda proxy response size limit does not apply to this host.

aws-lambda.reason: The API Gateway adapter still buffers the existing React SSR response. A local API Gateway v2 event fixture verifies UTF-8 byte limits and response formatting; no Lambda invocation was run.
constraints: The full UTF-8 HTML must fit within the configured limit before proxy response conversion.
This check does not preempt synchronous rendering or bound its memory.

cloudflare.reason: The Workers fetch adapter still passes the request directly to the shared renderer. This change has no new storage or host capability; a Workers isolate was not exercised.
constraints: Uses the request signal and Web timer APIs; production Workers clocks do not measure synchronous CPU time between I/O events.
No Node Container or Lambda proxy behavior is claimed for Workers.
